productDetail.slimUiHint: Uses the reduced SlimUi editor, which integrates directly into the product page instead of opening the full Printess editor. Not compatible with the full editor's merge template list, books or multi-page pricing - while active, those settings are hidden below and ignored on the storefront. SlimUi has its own single merge template setting instead.
productDetail.slimUiPlanNotice: SlimUi requires the SlimUi plan to be booked for your Printess account. Without it, products with this setting activated will not display correctly on the storefront.
productDetail.notConfigured: Printess is not fully configured yet. Please provide both the Service Token and the Shop Token in the plugin settings before assigning a template to this product.
productDetail.slimUiFeaturesHint: Optional SlimUi features for this product. Each one can be turned on independently.
productDetail.slimUiFeaturePageNavigationHint: SlimUi shows a strip of small page previews above the product image for switching between the pages of the design (front/back of a postcard, the pages of a calendar). While active, the gallery's own arrows, dots and thumbnail strip are hidden, since the page strip replaces them.
productDetail.slimUiFeatureThumbnailNavigationHint: The product gallery's own thumbnails and arrows tell SlimUi which page of the design the customer is looking at, so the editor shows that page's properties. Has no effect while "Page navigation" is active, which replaces that chrome with SlimUi's own page strip.
productDetail.slimUiMergeTemplateHint: One additional Printess template merged onto the template above when the SlimUi editor loads. Only applies while the SlimUi editor is activated.
productDetail.cacheDelayHint: Changes on this tab (template, form fields) are not shown immediately on the storefront product page. Depending on this shop's cache settings, it can take a few minutes (up to 5, or longer) for the storefront to reflect them after saving.
productDetail.perLanguageHint: These settings can differ per language. You are currently viewing/editing the version for the admin's currently selected language.
productDetail.sharedSettingsHint: These settings are shared across all languages and are saved immediately, independently of this page's own Save button.
productDetail.moreTemplatesHint: Showing {shown} of {total} matching templates. Keep typing to narrow down the results.
productDetail.loadError: Could not load templates from Printess.
productDetail.formFieldsHint: These name/value pairs are pushed to the Printess editor as form field values, in addition to the ones derived from the selected product variant. A value can either be fixed text, a variable resolved from the logged-in storefront customer (e.g. their name or billing address), or one of this product's own non-variant properties (e.g. "Material") - see "Source" per row. Non-variant properties are no longer pushed automatically; add one here to choose which form field name it's pushed as.
productDetail.formFieldValueFallbackHelpText: Used when no customer is logged in, or the selected variable isn't set on their account.
productDetail.formFieldNameCollisionError: "{name}" matches a product property used to build variants. This name is already pushed automatically and should not be set here.
productDetail.mergeTemplatesHint: Additional Printess templates that get merged onto the main template above when the editor opens.
productDetail.mergeModeLayoutSnippetNoRepeatPersistSti: Layout snippet - No repeat, persist stickers
productDetail.mergeModeLayoutSnippetRepeatAllPersistSt: Layout snippet - Repeat all, persist stickers
productDetail.mergeModeLayoutSnippetRepeatInsidePersis: Layout snippet - Repeat inside, persist stickers
productDetail.noLayoutSnippetsFound: No layout snippets found for this search.
productDetail.layoutSnippetSearchError: Could not search layout snippets on Printess.
productDetail.manualLayoutSnippetIdPlaceholder: Paste a layout snippet ID directly
productDetail.selectTagHint: Layout snippets are organized by tags. Select at least one tag above to load matching layout snippets; the search field then narrows down that list further.
productDetail.layoutSnippetKeywordsPlaceholder: Select one or more keywords to narrow down further...
productDetail.pricingHint: Add a surcharge based on the book's page count and/or on specific form field value combinations (e.g. paper material, binding type). Leave everything empty for plain product pricing.
productDetail.includedPageCountHelpText: Number of pages included in the base price. Pages beyond this are charged at the price per page below.
productDetail.pricePerPageHelpText: Added once per page beyond the included page count above.
productDetail.priceRulesHint: Each rule adds its price and/or price-per-page on top, only when ALL of its form field conditions match the values reported by the editor (e.g. "Material" equals "Premium", or the value's length is greater than 10). Multiple matching rules stack.
productDetail.priceRuleLabelHelpText: Shown to customers in the cart/order to explain this surcharge (e.g. "Premium paper") - one translation per shop language. Shown in the customer's own language if translated, otherwise falls back to your shop's default language, then to any other translation you did provide. Falls back to the matched conditions instead if left empty for every language.
productDetail.priceRuleConditionsLabel: Applies when all of these match:
productDetail.magicPhotobookEnabledLabel: Forward Magic Photobook settings to the editor
productDetail.photobookThemeHelpText: Defaults to "Do not use", since most products aren't Magic Photobooks. When set, the editor will display the selected theme on Magic Photobooks.
productDetail.insidePageCountHint: Sets a fixed number of inside pages. This is for regular book templates only - never use it together with a Magic Photobook. Use the toggle in front of the card title to control whether this is forwarded to the editor at all.
productDetail.insidePageCountEnabledLabel: Forward book inside page count to the editor
productDetail.insidePageCountHelpText: Must be at least 4. Leave empty to leave the page count up to the editor/template.
productDetail.insidePageCountConflictError: "Book inside page count" and "Magic Photobook settings" can't both be active at the same time - they're mutually exclusive ways of telling the editor how many pages the book should have. Deactivate the other one first.
productDetail.bookSettingSpineHelpText: A Length value (e.g. "2cm") or an equation (e.g. "=spine.pages * 0.3mm").
productDetail.bookSettingLengthHelpText: A Length value, e.g. "1cm", "2inch", or a plain number in pixels.
productDetail.bookSettingAddSpreadsHelpText: Minimum spreads to add; the spread count must also be divisible by this number to be printable.
productDetail.bookSettingUseDebossedCoverHelpText: Enables the debossed (premade) cover: it gets a fixed number of images and no theme cover layout is applied.

templateCheck.hint: Compares this product's variant properties with the template's form fields, as the storefront does when the editor reports a change. Fixed something in the Printess template, or changed the product's variants or properties? Check again to re-read both.
templateCheck.checkFailed: The template could not be checked. Please try again.
templateCheck.noVariantProperties: This product has no variant properties yet, so there is nothing to compare. You can build them from the template below.
templateCheck.notInTemplate: The template has no form field called “{option}”, so the selected option is not passed to the editor.
templateCheck.nameCase: The property “{option}” is called “{spelled}” in the template. Names must match exactly, including upper and lower case, or the option is not passed to the editor.
templateCheck.notPriceRelevant: The form field “{field}” is not set to Price Relevant in the template. The editor only reports changes to such fields, so changing it in the editor will not switch the variant.
templateCheck.valuesDiffer: “{option}” matches a template field, but not all of its values do.
templateCheck.synced: “{option}” is passed to the editor and follows changes made there.
templateCheck.valueCase: Upper and lower case differ: {pairs}. Values must match exactly.
templateCheck.countDiffers: The product has {productCount} values for “{option}”, the template field has {templateCount}.
templateCheck.freeField: “{option}” is not a list in the template, so its values are not compared.
templateCheck.nameTranslation: The property “{option}” is called “{spelled}” in the template, which is its name in another language. The storefront compares names in the shop's default language, so the option is not passed to the editor.
templateCheck.valueTranslation: Named in another language only: {pairs}. The storefront compares values in the shop's default language, so these do not match.

variantSync.openHint: Adds the template's list fields as variant properties and creates the variants, with a preview first.
variantSync.variantHint: Variants are built on the parent product. Open the parent product to build its variants from the template.
variantSync.title: Build variants from the template
variantSync.intro: Choose the template's list fields that should be variant properties of this product. The product then gets exactly their values, and one variant per combination. Existing variants are kept wherever they still fit, with their prices, stock and product numbers. Properties and their options are shared by all products, so existing ones are reused and never renamed or deleted.
variantSync.unsavedChanges: This product has unsaved changes. Save the product first, then apply.
variantSync.choicesHeading: Template fields to use as variant properties
variantSync.noChoices: This template has no list fields that could become variant properties.
variantSync.failed: The template could not be read. Please try again.
variantSync.openValues: Colour field: the product's own colours are used as its values.
variantSync.openNeedsGroup: Colour field: add the property with its colours to the product first, then it can be synced.
variantSync.notPriceRelevant: Not Price Relevant in the template: the editor will not switch the variant when this changes.
variantSync.becomesVariantProduct: This product has no variants yet. Applying gives it variants: they inherit its price, and from then on the variants are sold instead of the product itself.
variantSync.groupAddedToProduct: Adds the property “{group}” to this product
variantSync.hintOptions: These options are not in the template. Ticked ones are removed from this product, not from the shop; untick any this product should keep.
variantSync.otherGroups: Properties no chosen template field matches
variantSync.hintGroups: Ticked properties are removed from this product, not from the shop; untick any this product should keep.
variantSync.limit: Creates {created} of {missing} missing variants in this run. Open this dialog again afterwards for the rest.
variantSync.update: Updates {count} existing variants to the new options.
variantSync.hintVariants: Ticked variants are deleted; untick any to keep. A kept variant also keeps its properties and options.
variantSync.merged: {count} variants become duplicates and are merged
variantSync.mergedHelp: They differ only in a property that is being removed. The oldest one stays, with its price and stock. Keep that property to keep them apart.
variantSync.noteOpenNew: “{group}” was left out: a colour field takes the product's own colours, and the product has no such property yet.
variantSync.noteSharedGroupSpelling: The property “{group}” is spelled “{spelled}” in the template. Properties are shared with other products and are not renamed here: rename it under Catalogues › Properties, or the editor will not follow it.
variantSync.noteSharedValueSpelling: “{value}” in the property “{group}” is spelled “{spelled}” in the template. Options are shared with other products and are not renamed here: rename it under Catalogues › Properties, or the editor will not follow it.
variantSync.noteCloseoutStock: This product is set to closeout. New variants start with a stock of 0, so they cannot be bought until their stock is set.
variantSync.applyWarning: Applying saves the properties and variants straight away. Deleted variants cannot be restored.
variantSync.noteSharedGroupTranslation: The property “{group}” is reused for the template field “{spelled}”, which matches its name in another language. The storefront compares the shop's default language, so rename it under Catalogues › Properties, or the editor will not follow it.
variantSync.noteSharedValueTranslation: “{value}” in the property “{group}” is reused for the template value “{spelled}”, which matches its name in another language, instead of creating a duplicate. The storefront compares the shop's default language, so rename it under Catalogues › Properties, or the editor will not follow it.
